originalTitle: Thelio Mira AI Linux Workstation: 192 GB GPU Memory
content:
Accelerate your AI development with Thelio Mira AI, System76's affordable, GPU-focused workstations, built for local AI development — so you can train, fine-tune, and iterate challenging AI workloads entirely on your own hardware.

System76 branded hardware products come with the option for either a 1-year, 2-year or 3-year limited product warranty, except that all batteries and chargers are warranted for only one (1) year.

To ensure your order arrives smoothly, please be aware of our international shipping polices. System76 does not calculate or collect international taxes, duties, or brokerage fees at checkout. System76 does not cover shipping costs related to International warranty repairs.
